title: Package routes, discovery and HTTP operation projection
summary:
Ship the complete HTTP surface from the explicitly installed provider, including
discovery, capabilities, OpenAPI and correct async/deprecation responses.
why:
`@plan/knowledge/research-P13-design.json` §3.2–§4; D68; N07/S19/S31–S32. Handwritten host
wildcards are divergent and make the library incomplete as an API product.

exclude:
Content negotiation body (P13.9); public tenant capability leakage;
automatic provider discovery; host authentication implementation; bulk status lifecycle.

rules:
Discovery routes precede wildcard and use stable names. Disabled
routes register none. Root discovery is code-profile only; capability requires resolved principal/
tenant and filters hidden operations. `ErrorBoundary` surrounds operation pipeline. Async response
requires validated `operation_id`/absolute-or-prefix-relative `status_url`; add one Location.
Deprecation headers derive only from descriptor and standards formats.

validation.procedure: Route list exact with enabled/disabled/custom prefix; no duplicates across double boot
Capabilities differ by activation/policy without profile hash change. Forged tenant/workspace payload ignored
Async is 202+Location; sync unchanged. Deprecation/Sunset/Link exact golden tests

deliverables:
Package-owned opt-out routes, three discovery projections, async/deprecation
HTTP behavior and host migration documentation.
